purpose: Teach: 道中/抜け出し/母校/ためし/ところどころ/道理/平然と/此処

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんとお散歩の道中、楽しいわね
lines.en: Sho, this walk with big sis is turning out to be really nice, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle smile in the voice. Noticing something small and good. Unhurried pace, like she's thinking out loud with him, not at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達とお家を抜け出して公園に来たよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — me and my friend snuck out of the house and came to the park!
lines.style: Bright, slightly conspiratorial. Quick energy — he's eager to share his small adventure. Innocent excitement, not defiant. Watching her face for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの母校はここから歩いて十分なのよ
lines.en: Sho, my old school is just a ten-minute walk from here.
lines.style: Soft, a little distant. She's looking past the immediate moment toward something in her own past. Wondering tone — almost talking to herself. Pause before speaking, like memory is arriving.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ためしに新しい靴を履いてきたよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — I wore my new shoes today! Wanted to try them out.
lines.style: Proud, showing off a little. Lifting slightly on the news — he wants her to notice. Six-year-old confidence. Maybe standing a bit straighter when he mentions the shoes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園の花壇はところどころ綺麗ね
lines.en: Sho, look — the flower beds in the park are so pretty, aren't they? All scattered with color.
lines.style: Gentle observation shared. Softly wondering. She's pointing something out to him like it matters that he sees it too. Slower pace. Tender without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんから道理を教えてもらったよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — Grandpa taught me something about how things work. About reasons.
lines.style: Quiet, serious for a moment. He's holding something he learned close. Saying it like it matters. Slower than his usual eager-child pace. Looking at her to see if she understands why he's telling her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは何があっても平然としてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know — no matter what happens, big sis stays calm about things.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wistful. She's recognizing something about herself, maybe a little tired behind it. Not boasting — observing. Quieter, like she's admitting something true about the distance she keeps.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、此処にお絵描きしてもいい?
lines.en: Big sis Mei — can I draw something here? On the ground?
lines.style: Hesitant, curious, asking permission. Soft voice. He wants to do something and he wants her to say yes. Not demanding — genuinely seeking approval. Leaning in slightly, genuine six-year-old wonder.
